items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: I used to like his playing and I used to like his solo work because I just like that slap effect he had. I mean I can slap a little but I never could perfect it as well as Cleo.

ctx.x: By what year was that? How old was that?

Cleo was popular from I'd say as far as I can remember from around 29 or 30 up until the war started. He got killed on a merchant ship because he went to the merchant marine and the ship he was on was bombed somewhere out of sea. But he was very popular around New Orleans as a bass player. Very nice bass player. I used to like his playing and I used to like his solo work because I just like that slap effect he had. I mean I can slap a little but I never could perfect it as well as Cleo. He is real good. I think…
What kind of a bow do you use, what they call the French style like a violin or the German where you put your hand in?
